user_sees: Sheet 'New challenge' with 'Name', 'What counts', the goal, 'First day' ('Today or a later day, up to 60 days from today.'), 'How many days' ('From 7 to 31 days.'), 'Free days for everyone who reaches the goal'
must_not: The sheet opens while offline (button must read 'Needs internet')

user_sees: The running challenge card with its goal and days; members see it in their app
must_not: Two challenges from one save, or a challenge in another branch

steps.action: Tap the turn-on button of a ready-made card
user_sees: The card shows as on, with the numbers that were saved; 'Change' and a red turn-off button
must_not: A second running challenge when one is already on

steps.action: Save a challenge with 5 days or an empty name
user_sees: A plain problem line in the sheet; nothing saved (exact words not read)
must_not: A challenge saved with days outside 7 to 31

steps.action: Open Challenges in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Challenges need your gym online' / 'Members' phones read the challenge from your gym's server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'

start: Challenges, one challenge running, some members reached the goal

steps.action: Confirm the free days for the members who reached the goal, or tap 'Skip' on one
user_sees: A line saying what was given to whom; the member leaves the waiting list
must_not: Free days given twice to one member

user_sees: 'Cancel this challenge?' with a red button
After it: 'No challenge is running' and 'Turn on a ready-made challenge above, or make your own with “New challenge”.'
must_not: Members still seeing the cancelled challenge as running

steps.action: Hide a member from the leaderboard
user_sees: The member moves under 'Hidden from the leaderboard' with 'Show <name> on the leaderboard again'
must_not: A hidden member still shown to other members in the app

user_sees: 'Only the owner can start, change or cancel a challenge. You can see who has reached the goal.'
The running challenge, who reached the goal, and the leaderboard
'No challenge is running' / 'The owner has not started one.'
must_not: Any button that starts, changes or cancels a challenge

start: Challenges open on the desk while the owner cancels the challenge on another device

must_not: The old challenge still shown as running after a reload
